cues: We usually think things happen on their own when they release energy, like a ball rolling downhill.
This one sucks energy in from its surroundings, and still goes, all by itself.
Energy alone cannot be the whole story.
By the end of this lesson you will know the second driving force of all chemistry.
text: Wait. We usually think things happen on their own when they release energy, like a ball rolling downhill. This one sucks energy in from its surroundings, and still goes, all by itself. Why? Energy alone cannot be the whole story. By the end of this lesson you will know the second driving force of all chemistry.
